_comment: Boot-validation issues that a human has been asked to rule on and that must
NOT block the build in the meantime. A waiver downgrades one issue id from
error to warning; the warning is printed on EVERY boot, so nothing is hidden.
Every id here MUST have a matching entry in /DECISIONS_NEEDED.md.
Deleting an entry restores the hard failure.

waivers.reason: DECISIONS_NEEDED.md D1 - speed_boost is a UI icon flag; the actual speed change comes from stats.speed_mod, which WeightClass applies from every slot. Awaiting a call on whether effects.speed_boost.slot_kinds should include 'utility'.
